title: Meaning of work and post-retirement employment survival: evidence from a time-to-event analysis in Java, Indonesia
core_idea: Examine how five dimensions of the meaning of work (financial, personal, social, generativity, spiritual) relate to the duration of post-retirement employment among retirees aged 53 and older in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, using structured interviews (N=230) and time-to-event methods (Gompertz survival analysis with robustness checks).
tldr: A time-to-event study using interviews of 230 Indonesian retirees to assess how different meanings of work influence how long people stay employed after retirement.
